verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both keep the brand, the hierarchy and the illustration intact, but they scale the whole stack down and push it toward the top. That leaves a large empty band of about 100px below the #FlattenTheCurve/#StayAtHome hashtags, so the layout feels top-heavy. The small kicker text and hashtags also get quite small at this size, and the phone illustrations sit close to the side edges.
